observations: Photo 0 shows a dining table with a marble-patterned top and six upholstered chairs with tufted backs, arranged in a room with white walls and curtains.
Photo 1 shows the same dining set from a different angle, with the table and chairs clearly visible. The chairs have a beige or light brown velvet-like fabric with black legs.
The table has a reflective, polished surface with a brown and grey marble pattern.
The chairs have high backs with button tufting and black legs.
The room has white walls with a wainscoting lower half, and a window with sheer curtains and dark frames.
The table appears to be made of a solid material with a marble-patterned top, possibly laminate or veneer over wood.
The chairs appear to be upholstered fabric, likely polyester or microfiber, with some visible wear or discoloration on the fabric, especially on the lower part of the backrests.
No brand or model is visible on any part of the furniture in either photo.
The seller claims 'Full complete dining set 6 chairs (carton color)' and 'No defect'.
